Planning Commission Meeting
PLANNING COMMISSION MEETING
CITY HALL COUNCIL CHAMBER
38300 SIERRA HIGHWAY, SUITE B
PALMDALE, CALIFORNIA
Thursday APRIL 8, 2021
07:00 P.M.
www.cityofpalmdale.org
WELCOME
NOTICE: This meeting will be simulcast live on Time Warner Channel 27 and at www.cityofpalmdale.org.
PLEASE NOTE:
For record keeping purposes, if you wish to make a statement regarding any item on the agenda, please complete the Speaker Slip located on the side table and deposit it with the Deputy City Clerk. (Note: There is a three-minute time limit per speaker imposed. Please stay within this limit.)
In accordance with the Americans with Disabilities Act of 1990, if you require a disability-related modification or accommodation to attend or participate in this meeting, including auxiliary aids or services, please call the Planning Division at 661/267 5200 at least 48 hours prior to the meeting.
Your courtesy is requested to help our meeting run smoothly. If you'll be kind enough to follow these simple rules, we can make the best possible use of your time and ours:
If you wish to speak on an item, please fill out a Speaker's Slip and deliver it to the Deputy City Clerk BEFORE the item is discussed.
Please refrain from public displays or outbursts such as unsolicited applause, comments or cheering.
Any disruptive activities that substantially interfere with the ability of the Planning Commission to carry out its meeting will not be permitted and offenders will be requested to leave the meeting.
Please turn off cell phones and electronic devices.
1. CALL TO ORDER
2. PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE TO THE FLAG
3. ROLL CALL: Chair Nemeth, Vice Chair Avery, Commissioner Fraga-Saenz, Henderson, and Smith
4. REVIEW OF AGENDA
5. MOTION TO WAIVE FULL READING OF ALL RESOLUTIONS ON THE AGENDA FOR THIS MEETING
6. PUBLIC COMMENTS ON CONSENT CALENDAR ITEMS AND ANY ITEMS NOT ON THE AGENDA

7A. Approval of Minutes from the Regular Planning Commission Meeting of March 11, 2021
7A
8. PUBLIC HEARINGS
8A. Conditional Use Permit 19-016 - Mr. Gilto E. Lara, Applicant
A request to expand an existing restaurant and establish a Type 41 (On-Sale Beer and Wine) Alcoholic Beverage Control License for a bona fide restaurant located at 1645 East Palmdale Boulevard (Lorocco's).
Staff Recommendation: It is recommended that the Planning Commission adopt RESOLUTION NO. PC-2021-011 approving Conditional Use Permit 19-016 and find that the project is Categorically Exempt from environmental review. Staff Reference: Jasmine Alvarado, Assistant Planner
8A
8B. Tentative Parcel Map 83189, Conditional Use Permit 21-001, and Site Plan Review 21-001 - Pilot Travel Centers, LLC, Applicant
A Request to Subdivide one parcel into three parcels and to construct a commercial travel center located north of Pearblossom Highway and west of Fort Tejon Road/Highway 138 (APN: 3051-021-022).
Staff Recommendation: It is recommended that the Planning Commission adopt RESOLUTION NO. PC-2021-010 approving Tentative Parcel Map 83189, Conditional Use Permit 21-001, and Site Plan Review 21-001 and adopt the Mitigated Negative Declaration and Mitigation Monitoring and Reporting Program, finding that the project will not result in a significant impact to the environment. Staff Reference: Megan Taggart, Planning Manager

Staff Recommendation: It is recommended that the Planning Commission adopt RESOLUTION NO. PC-2021-009 denying Appeal 21-001 and upholding HEARING OFFICER DETERMINATION NO. 2021-002. Staff Reference: Justin Sauder, Associate Planner
